pr_title: [API] Fix 9544 | return 200 when reaction already exist
pr_comments: Is StatusOK really right here ? - I would have thought StatusConflict would have been better? However, I think there's a place for putting a 200 here.

We can still decide wich status we return - github does it the 200 way [reverence: link](https://developer.github.com/v3/reactions/#create-reaction-for-a-commit-comment)

But this is also a smal code/refactor <- now we can explicit handle dubble add and filter/find reactions by more options

issue_context.title: [Bug Report] Reactions API throws 500 for duplicate reaction
issue_context.body:
## Description

If we post a same reaction more than one time via reaction API, it will throw 500.

https://gitea.com/api/swagger#/issue/issuePostCommentReaction

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments/{id}/reactions`

FYI, GitHub returns `201` for created, and returns `200` for duplicated

cc @6543 

## Screenshots

**First Time (OK)**

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18205362/71576329-4043e180-2b2b-11ea-9d4f-4e3d6152c628.png)



**Second Time (ERROR)**

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18205362/71576326-37eba680-2b2b-11ea-813b-e967b365e119.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18205362/71576170-9fedbd00-2b2a-11ea-95f6-19332cbc502b.png)
comments:
The Api works as intended (500 is xorm error ...)

I could change this ...

Yes, a `5xx` code means things do not work as expected.

BTW, I think the error details should not be exposed
